title: Shine on the Shore
meta_description: Welcome to Shine on the Shore, a stunning 4-bedroom retreat on the Emerald Coast. Just 0.9 miles from Deer Park Beach, enjoy a bright, open layout, resort-style pools, and a provided golf cart.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Shine on the Shore, your dream retreat on the stunning Emerald Coast! This beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom house is the perfect haven for your group getaway. With its bright, open layout, the central area combines the living room, dining space, and fully equipped kitchen, creating the ideal spot for everyone to gather and make lasting memories. Enjoy cozy movie nights in the living room, share delicious meals at the dining table for six, and whip up your favorite dishes on the gas range in the stylish kitchen.

Beach days are a breeze, with public beach access just 5 minutes away. You'll appreciate the provided golf cart to quickly and effortlessly transport your crew and beach gear to the shore. Two resort-style community pools are also waiting to help you stay cool under the Florida sun.

After a day of seaside adventures, rinse off in the convenient outdoor shower before unwinding on the shaded front porch, where comfortable seating and a fan offer a perfect end to your day.

The sleeping arrangements are flexible and inviting: the primary suite boasts a king bed and ensuite bathroom, while two guest rooms feature queen beds, and a fourth bedroom with two twin-over-twin bunk beds ensures everyone has a space to rest their head. With convenient parking and in-home laundry, Shine on the Shore offers all the comforts of home in a blissful beachside setting.

You'll also be located right behind The Big Chill 30a (previously The Hub 30a), one of the Emerald Coast's top destinations. This buzzing plaza has everything from restaurants and shopping to activities and events, making it a must-see for families and groups of all types.

Come experience the charm and beauty of Shine on the Shore, where every detail is designed to make your stay unforgettable.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure views, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: St. Andrews State Park, Camp Helen State Park, Ms. Newby's and Runaway Island (karaoke), Jimmy Buffett's Margaritaville, Pier Park, Gulf World Marine Park, Water Planet, Little Village Waterfront Shopping Market, SkyWheel, Shipwreck Island Waterpark.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- The Northside pool is heated seasonally, but this is subject to change at any time by the HOA. We are not responsible for changes to the seasonal heating schedule, and no refunds will be issued for changes to the pool heating.

Parking Details:
- 2 cars can be parked onsite.
- The community has overflow parking available on a first-come, first-served basis.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

STR Permit Registration Number: STR24-002098

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
Accessibility: Lit path to the guest entrance
